Updates the App Protection profile for the specified ID and associates all predefined controls to a profile.
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/inspectionProfile/:inspectionProfileId/associateAllPredefinedControls

Updates the App Protection profile for the specified ID and associates all predefined controls to a profile.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

inspectionProfileId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the AppProtection profile.

QUERY PARAMETERS
version
string
REQUIRED

The predefined control version.
